commands.review_summary:
The PR adds aggregate `logWarn` summaries when three session JSONL readers skip malformed lines and adds `parseSessionEntries` warning regression tests.

PR surface: Source +28, Tests +72. Total +100 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: current main and the latest release catch malformed JSONL parse errors in the three session-manager reader loops and continue without `logWarn`. I did not run a local repro because this review was read-only.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A repair lane can add the missing focused assertions without product or ownership decisions; no runtime behavior change is needed.

target.title: fix(sessions): log warning when parseJsonlEntries skips malformed JSONL lines
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Three JSONL reader functions in session-manager.ts silently skip malformed transcript lines with bare catch blocks and zero diagnostic output. When a transcript file is corrupted, entries vanish with no operator visibility — no log, no warning, no metric.

This adds counted malformed-line detection and a single logWarn summary to all three readers: parseJsonlEntries (session load), buildSessionInfo (session listing), and parseSessionEntries (CLI history, BTW continuation, fork-source, embedded file state).

## Why This Change Was Made

Data loss without observability is the worst failure mode. The write side was hardened (serializeJsonLine throws on non-serializable roots), but transcripts already on disk from older code remain vulnerable. This adds the reader-side counterpart.

## User Impact

Operators will see warnings like:
  parseJsonlEntries: skipped 3 malformed JSONL line(s) — 142 valid entries were loaded
  buildSessionInfo: skipped 1 malformed JSONL line(s) in /path — 99 valid entries were loaded
  parseSessionEntries: skipped 2 malformed JSONL line(s) — 50 valid entries were loaded

Clean transcripts produce zero extra output. No behavior change to entry loading.

## Evidence

47/47 tests pass with no regression:
  pnpm test src/agents/sessions/session-manager.test.ts
   Test Files  1 passed (1)
        Tests  47 passed (47)

   pnpm test src/config/sessions/transcript-jsonl.test.ts
   Test Files  1 passed (1)
        Tests  10 passed (10)

## Risk

Low. One logWarn per reader using existing logger. No config, auth, or API changes.
